title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 005
review_goal: Differentiate the next five MingCute settings variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Hexagon settings cog badge with a centered ring and small inner circle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a settings symbol built from a hexagonal badge rather than a gear or sliders.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for gear or slider controls when the visible form is a hexagon around a center ring.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a clean hexagon shell with a target like center instead of teeth or horizontal controls.

items.depicts_observation: Three horizontal slider lines with plus shaped handles instead of a gear
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs adjustable settings shown as horizontal control lines with movable handles.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for gear shaped settings icons when the visible form is three slider rows with handle crosses.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected settings variant made from three horizontal lines and offset handles.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded cog ring with a centered circle inside an eight lobe outline
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a settings cog with rounded scalloped lobes around a centered circle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the sharper star gear or hex badge variants when the rounded lobes are the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a soft scalloped gear rim rather than the pointed gear star used by settings_4.

items.depicts_observation: Pointed cog star with a centered circle inside an eight point outline
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a sharper settings cog with visible pointed teeth around the center ring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounded scalloped gear when the tooth shape needs to stay visibly angular.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from settings_3 by using sharper pointed teeth around the gear outline.

items.depicts_observation: Classic gear ring with a centered circle and many rounded teeth
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most traditional gear wheel symbol for settings or system controls.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the hex badge slider bars or pointed star gear when the many teeth matter visually.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the densest gear wheel with many teeth around the center instead of a simple lobe shape.
